answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Reaching the pigment of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the forge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the dawn of the next round.
